name: Former NEEL Developer
source:
[spoiler]NEEL unofficial community founder (in Hajime 's novel) and former NEEL developer team 's leader.
Yukari ex-boyfriend.
He travel around the world after retired from work and break off relations with Yukari.
10~ years later, he back to Japan and live in Kyushu with his mother and start develop new application platfrom.[/spoiler]
